entries.title: Pickpocket Brush
entries.prompt: A child in a thin coat bumps the lead member and is gone before anyone reacts.

suggested.text: A coin pouch is lighter than it should be.

entries.title: Bribe Offered
entries.prompt: A nervous clerk slides a small purse across a desk in exchange for looking the other way.
entries.gmHook: Take the money and you owe the clerk a favor in two scenarios.

entries.title: Loose Grate
entries.prompt: A rusted grate gives way underfoot.

entries.title: Lost Coin Pouch
entries.prompt: A small pouch wedged between cobbles. Someone dropped it.

entries.title: Phosphor Drip
entries.prompt: Glowing goo drips from the ceiling. Someone bottles it.

entries.title: Kind Innkeeper
entries.prompt: A weathered innkeeper waves the party to the back kitchen and ladles hot stew.

entries.title: Market Argument
entries.prompt: Two stalls are screaming about a stolen scale. Both want the party to weigh in.
entries.gmHook: Whichever side loses gets pinned as a recurring complaint NPC.

suggested.text: GM: pick a side. Other side becomes hostile-light.

entries.title: Rooftop Runner
entries.prompt: A figure leaps roof to roof above the party, trailing snow.
entries.gmHook: Recurring stalker. Can become a rival, an informant, or a missing childhood friend.

entries.title: Temple Question
entries.prompt: A novice asks the party an awkward theological question about miracles in wartime.
entries.gmHook: Free belief beat for any character. Pin and use later for a chapter break.

suggested.text: GM: pick which member answers and how it lands.

entries.title: Back-Alley Smith
entries.prompt: A smith offers to engrave a name into a blade for cheap. The smith asks who hurt the bearer.
entries.gmHook: Engraved blade can become a custom item next chapter.

suggested.text: GM: pick whose blade was engraved and what name was carved.

entries.title: Someone Wearing Bin's Face
entries.prompt: Half a dozen witnesses swear they saw Bin in another part of town an hour ago.
entries.gmHook: Heavy plot bait. Pin only if the GM wants the missing-year mystery to escalate.

suggested.text: Someone wearing Bin's face was seen in town.

entries.title: Corvin's Paperwork
entries.prompt: Corvin needs three signatures and at least one witness to confirm Bin is alive enough to sign for jobs.
entries.gmHook: Soft hook into the existing 'Ledger of the Ghost' chain.

suggested.text: Corvin will not let this go.
